nf1e9915e8e6.s:
Consider the following statements about the International Telecommunication Union (ITU):
1. It was established in 1865 and is the oldest UN agency.
2. It has 194 members.
3. It is headquartered in London.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nf1e9915e8e6.x: ITU was established in 1865, is the oldest UN agency and has 194 members (India joined in 1869); it is not headquartered in London.

nd3629976727.s: Which of the following pairs (head of UN agency – nationality) is correctly matched?
nd3629976727.x: Tedros is Ethiopian. Qu Dongyu is Chinese, Celeste Saulo is Argentine and Arsenio Dominguez is Panamanian.

nfc4a19a348c.s: Rafael Grossi and Rebeca Grynspan, candidates for UN Secretary-General in 2026, head respectively:
nfc4a19a348c.x: Rafael Grossi is Director General of the IAEA and Rebeca Grynspan is Secretary-General of UNCTAD.

n2fe4383990e.s: The ITU Council accepted India's bid to host which event in 2030?
o: World Summit on the Information Society
n2fe4383990e.x: The ITU Council accepted India's bid to host the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference 2030, known as PP-30.

n992f8a5cdab.s:
Consider the following criticisms of the WTO and the Bretton Woods institutions:
1. The WTO Appellate Body is paralysed.
2. India is blocking the Investment Facilitation for Development (IFD) agreement.
3. The Bretton Woods institutions have abolished quota-based voting.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n992f8a5cdab.x: The criticisms are WTO paralysis through the Appellate Body, India's blocking of IFD and a continuing voting imbalance in the Bretton Woods institutions; quota voting has not been abolished.

nf11ec956293.s: Which of the following pairs (country – WHO certification) is correctly matched?
o: Bhutan – First in Africa to end onchocerciasis
Timor-Leste – First in WHO South-East Asia Region to eliminate dog-transmitted rabies
Chile – First in the Americas to eliminate leprosy
nf11ec956293.x: Chile was the first in the Americas to eliminate leprosy. Bhutan eliminated dog-transmitted rabies, Niger ended onchocerciasis and Timor-Leste became malaria-free.

n4446eb220b6.s: In the WHO Pandemic Agreement negotiations, India backs which grouping?
n4446eb220b6.x: India backs the developing-country Group for Equity in the negotiations on the WHO Pandemic Agreement.

n44dc94be9c4.s:
Consider the following statements about the India-Oman CEPA:
1. It provides duty-free treatment for 99% of India's exports.
2. It is India's first CEPA with a GCC country.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n44dc94be9c4.x: The India-Oman CEPA (signed December 2025, in force June 2026) makes 99% of India's exports duty-free; it is India's second GCC CEPA, not the first.

nc6eafdbd5ca.x: India had 15 FTAs covering 27 countries as of June 2026.

n6c32ee644cd.s:
Consider the following statements about S&P's rating of India:
1. In 2025, S&P upgraded India from BBB- to BBB, its first upgrade in nearly two decades.
2. In September 2026, S&P downgraded India to BBB-.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n6c32ee644cd.x: S&P upgraded India from BBB- to BBB in 2025 and affirmed (did not downgrade) the BBB rating in September 2026.

n01e4cbb006a.s: The WTO e-commerce moratorium lapsed in March 2026 after the failure of which Ministerial Conference?
n01e4cbb006a.x: The failure of MC14 and the lapse of the e-commerce moratorium were reported in March 2026.

n8fe7e5fe030.s: The Global Investment Trends Monitor is published by:
n8fe7e5fe030.x: The Global Investment Trends Monitor is a UNCTAD publication; it reported India's FDI rising 73% to $47 billion in 2025.

n42e6982c696.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Hague Conventions (HCCH) – UK–EU post-Brexit trade rules for Northern Ireland
n42e6982c696.x: The Stockholm Convention (2001) covers persistent organic pollutants. Chicago is civil aviation, HCCH is private international law and the Windsor Framework covers Northern Ireland trade rules.

nfe590bb9340.s:
Consider the following statements about the Minamata Convention (2013):
1. It concerns mercury.
2. It requires dental amalgam to be phased out by 2034.
3. It regulates persistent organic pollutants.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nfe590bb9340.x: The Minamata Convention concerns mercury, with dental amalgam to be phased out by 2034; POPs belong to the Stockholm Convention.

n5e7ae3f6971.s:
With reference to the five UN outer-space treaties, consider the following:
1. India has signed all five treaties.
2. India has ratified the Moon Agreement of 1979.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n5e7ae3f6971.x: India has signed all five and ratified four; the exception is the 1979 Moon Agreement, which India has not ratified.

n69658d0eb74.s: The General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) was signed in ____ and came into force in ____.
n69658d0eb74.x: GATT was signed in 1947 and entered into force in 1948.

n2d92c0cef5b.s:
India's refusal to join which of the following has been defended as protecting policy space?
1. Investment Facilitation for Development
2. Cybercrime Convention
3. Pandemic Agreement
n2d92c0cef5b.x: India's refusals on the IFD initiative and the Cybercrime Convention were defended as protecting policy space; the Pandemic Agreement is a separate matter as its PABS annex remains incomplete.

nc2efe6f8849.s:
Consider the following statements about NATO's enlargement:
1. Finland became NATO's 31st member in 2023.
2. Sweden became NATO's 32nd member in 2024.
3. Finland and Sweden joined NATO on the same day.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nc2efe6f8849.x: Finland joined as the 31st member in 2023 and Sweden as the 32nd in 2024, so they did not join on the same day.

n62bd9c03580.s:
The India-EU FTA is to operate along with which of the following?
1. An Investment Protection Agreement
2. A Geographical Indications Agreement
3. A Nuclear Liability Convention
n62bd9c03580.x: The India-EU FTA is to operate with an Investment Protection Agreement and a Geographical Indications Agreement; no Nuclear Liability Convention accompanies it.

n85b06d34c4d.s: The BRICS Contingency Reserve Arrangement is intended to provide:
o: IMF-type liquidity support for BRICS members
n85b06d34c4d.x: The BRICS Contingency Reserve Arrangement provides BRICS members an alternative to IMF liquidity support.

nb7e7f7e24ef.s: Which of the following INTERPOL notices is correctly matched with its purpose?
o: Blue Notice – Locate and arrest a wanted person pending extradition
Silver Notice – Information on a person's identity, location or activities
nb7e7f7e24ef.x: The Yellow Notice is for missing persons. Red is to locate and arrest pending extradition, Blue seeks information on identity/location, and Silver (2025) traces criminal assets.

n50434089983.s:
Consider the following statements about the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB):
1. It was established in 2016.
2. It has 111 approved members.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n50434089983.x: AIIB was established in 2016 and has 111 approved members.

naedcc61075e.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The World Bank's Global Economic Prospects is issued in January and June.
2. World Development Report 2025, 'Standards for Development', is an IMF report.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
naedcc61075e.x: Global Economic Prospects is issued in January and June (India's FY26 forecast raised from 6.3% to 7.2%); the World Development Report is a World Bank report.

n51e1ae380db.s:
Consider the following statements about the IMF's growth projections for India:
1. In January 2026, it raised the 2025-26 projection to 7.3 per cent.
2. In April 2026, it projected FY27 growth at 7.3 per cent.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n51e1ae380db.x: The IMF raised 2025-26 to 7.3 per cent in January 2026 and projected about 6.2 per cent (not 7.3) for FY27 in April 2026.

n9de5481d123.s:
Which of the following international roles are associated with India in 2026?
1. Chair of the Kimberley Process
2. Host of ITU PP-30
3. Founder of ISA, CDRI and GBA
n9de5481d123.x: India chairs the Kimberley Process in 2026, is to host ITU PP-30 and is a founder of the ISA, CDRI and GBA.

n1424ed645e7.s: Which of the following is a Maastricht criterion for entry into the Eurozone?
n1424ed645e7.x: Eurozone entry criteria include a fiscal deficit below 3% of GDP, debt below 60% of GDP and participation in ERM II.

ne684ac94472.s:
Consider the following statements about India's Act East Policy:
1. It was upgraded from the Look East Policy (1991) in 2014.
2. It focuses mainly on the Gulf and West Asia.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ne684ac94472.x: Look East (1991) was upgraded to Act East in 2014, focusing on ASEAN, Japan and South Korea; the Gulf/West Asia focus is Link West.

n8cea2b7da05.s:
Consider the following statements about the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative (IPOI):
1. It originated at the East Asia Summit in Bangkok in 2019.
2. It has seven pillars.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n8cea2b7da05.x: IPOI originated at the East Asia Summit in Bangkok in 2019 and has seven pillars.

n9dcef2b2ec1.s: Heavy reliance on Russian defence platforms has been criticised mainly because it:
o: Limits diversification of India's defence suppliers
n9dcef2b2ec1.x: Dependence on Russian platforms is criticised because it limits diversification of India's defence procurement sources.

n235407ccf24.s: Which of the following pairs (grouping – members/feature) is correctly matched?
o: Pax Silica – India joined in February 2024
n235407ccf24.x: IMT-TRILAT comprises India, Tanzania and Mozambique. Quad is India, US, Japan, Australia; I2U2 is India, Israel, UAE, US; India joined Pax Silica in February 2026.

n722f9136411.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. IPEF is a US-led Indo-Pacific economic framework that includes India.
2. India holds the SCO chairmanship for 2026–27.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n722f9136411.x: IPEF is a US-led framework that includes India; Pakistan, not India, holds the SCO chairmanship for 2026–27.

n48cb1e24b8d.s:
Regarding the UK–Israel diplomatic dispute of September 2026, consider the following:
1. The UK banned trade with illegal Israeli settlements.
2. Israel shut Britain's Jerusalem consulate.
3. The UK recognised all Israeli settlements as legal.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n48cb1e24b8d.x: The UK (with France and Canada) banned trade with illegal Israeli settlements, and Israel shut Britain's Jerusalem consulate in response.

n8dcfc1fe5bd.s: Which of the following Indian operations is correctly matched with its purpose?
o: Sindhu – HADR to Venezuela after earthquakes
Sagar Bandhu – Evacuation of Indians from Iran/West Asia
Amistad – HADR to Sri Lanka after Cyclone Ditwah
Brahma – Relief to Myanmar after the 2025 earthquake
n8dcfc1fe5bd.x: Operation Brahma was relief to Myanmar after the 2025 earthquake. Sindhu was evacuation from Iran/West Asia, Sagar Bandhu was Sri Lanka after Cyclone Ditwah and Amistad was Venezuela.

n881c5e4846a.s:
Regarding India's response to the 2026 West Asia crisis, consider the following:
1. India deployed Navy escort missions named Sankalp and Urja Suraksha.
2. India joined the US–Israel attacks on Iran.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n881c5e4846a.x: India deployed the Navy escort missions Sankalp and Urja Suraksha amid the disruption around Hormuz; it did not join the attacks.

na5789370584.s:
Consider the following statements about the Quad:
1. It comprises India, the United States, Japan and Australia.
2. It has a permanent Quad-level 2+2 Ministerial Dialogue.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
na5789370584.x: The Quad is India, the US, Japan and Australia; it has no Quad 2+2, though bilateral 2+2 mechanisms exist among all four members.

na1aa6d7385f.s:
Consider the following statements about the Kalvari-class submarines:
1. The P-75 programme comprises six of them.
2. INS Vaghsheer, the last of the class, was delivered in 2024.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
na1aa6d7385f.x: P-75 comprises six Kalvari-class Scorpene submarines; INS Vaghsheer, the last, was delivered in 2025, not 2024.

n5020ea26267.x: NISAR observes glaciers, earthquakes, land subsidence and biomass, among other Earth-system features.

n609b04804e1.s: Astra Mk 1, developed by DRDO, is a:
n609b04804e1.x: Astra Mk 1 is a DRDO-developed beyond-visual-range air-to-air missile; Indonesia was its first export destination.

nf966c3ac10b.s:
Regarding the criticism of ISRO and the 2023 Space Policy, consider the following:
1. ISRO staff unions questioned outsourcing under the policy.
2. The criticism followed two consecutive PSLV failures.
3. The Department of Space abolished the 2023 Space Policy.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nf966c3ac10b.x: After two PSLV failures in a row, ISRO staff unions questioned outsourcing under the 2023 Space Policy; the policy was not abolished.

ndf8d89c112f.s:
Consider the following statements about the R78C malaria vaccine:
1. It was developed by Oxford and the Serum Institute of India.
2. It targets blood-stage antigens such as RIPR and CyPRA.
3. It is the first malaria drug for newborns.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ndf8d89c112f.x: R78C is from Oxford and the Serum Institute and targets blood-stage antigens (RIPR, CyPRA); the first malaria drug for newborns is Coartem Baby.

n37877493de8.s:
Consider the following statements about NIELIT Amaravati:
1. It is a MeitY initiative.
2. Its outlay is ₹730.70 crore.
3. Its classes are to begin at IIT Madras.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n37877493de8.x: NIELIT Amaravati is a MeitY initiative costing ₹730.70 crore; classes are to begin in September 2026 at ANU, Guntur, not IIT Madras.

nc10804cc08d.s: The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Ituri, DRC, declared a PHEIC by WHO in May 2026, spread to:
nc10804cc08d.x: The Bundibugyo virus outbreak in Ituri, DRC, spread to Uganda; WHO declared it a PHEIC in May 2026.

na618da3ab54.s:
Consider the following statements about Vikram-1 ('Aagaman'):
1. It was built by Skyroot Aerospace, Hyderabad.
2. It made India the third country, after the US and China, with a privately developed orbital rocket.
3. It was built by ISRO's Satish Dhawan Space Centre.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
na618da3ab54.x: Vikram-1 (18 July 2026) is Skyroot Aerospace's private orbital rocket, making India the third country after the US and China; it was not built by ISRO.

n2d0d818b072.s: Which of the following pairs (facility – location) is correctly matched?
o: Indian Biological Data Centre – Hanle, Ladakh
n2d0d818b072.x: LIGO-India is located at Hingoli in Maharashtra, and L&T won the DAE contract to build it.

n064f3b5cecc.s: Dipturus dhritiae, reported in September 2026, is a:
o: Wolf snake from Great Nicobar Island
Deep-sea skate from the Arabian Sea
Ray spider from a cave in Meghalaya
n064f3b5cecc.x: Dipturus dhritiae is a deep-sea skate from the Arabian Sea, discovered under the Deep Ocean Mission and named after Dhriti Banerjee, the first woman Director of ZSI.

na89f4d198da.s: Which of the following pairs (report – agency) is correctly matched?
o: Environmental Performance Index 2026 – Germanwatch, NewClimate Institute and CAN
Climate Change Performance Index 2026 – CSE and Down To Earth
State of India's Environment 2026 in Figures – Yale and Columbia Universities
na89f4d198da.x: The Climate Risk Index 2025 is by Germanwatch. EPI is by Yale and Columbia, CCPI by Germanwatch, NewClimate Institute and CAN, and State of India's Environment by CSE and Down To Earth.

n09ec4520a86.s: From September 2026, gaur are to be translocated to which tiger reserve in Andhra Pradesh?
n09ec4520a86.x: From September 2026, gaur are to be translocated to NSTR, which is also to receive four female tigers from Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh.

nb7b91d8aa6a.s: Under IUCN Red List 2026-1, the numbat was moved from:
nb7b91d8aa6a.x: The numbat was downlisted from Endangered to Near Threatened; the desert rain frog was uplisted from Near Threatened to Vulnerable.

n6bacbd6a638.s: Which of the following COP – venue pairs is correctly matched?
n6bacbd6a638.x: COP29 was held in Baku. COP28 was in Dubai, COP30 in Belém and COP31 is scheduled for Antalya.

nbfd3661eb9a.s:
Consider the following statements about COP33:
1. India withdrew its bid to host it through a letter dated 2 April 2026.
2. It is scheduled for 2028.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nbfd3661eb9a.x: India withdrew its bid to host COP33, scheduled for 2028, through a letter dated 2 April 2026.

nc1f87d3d711.s:
Consider the following statements about the NDC Transport Initiative for Asia:
1. It is funded by Germany's International Climate Initiative.
2. It covers China, India and Vietnam.
3. It is led by the UAE and Indonesia.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nc1f87d3d711.x: The initiative is funded by Germany's International Climate Initiative and focuses on decarbonising transport in China, India and Vietnam; the UAE and Indonesia lead the Mangrove Alliance for Climate.

n9a38819dc7e.s: Which of the following pairs (initiative – lead/feature) is correctly matched?
o: Mangrove Alliance for Climate – India-led, headquartered in New Delhi
International Big Cat Alliance – Launched by Brazil at COP30
Tropical Forest Forever Facility – Led by UAE and Indonesia
Global River Cities Alliance – Led by the National Mission for Clean Ganga
n9a38819dc7e.x: GRCA is led by the National Mission for Clean Ganga. MAC is led by the UAE and Indonesia, IBCA is India-led (HQ New Delhi) and TFFF was launched by Brazil at COP30.

nf14349cba52.x: Madhav National Park in Shivpuri district of Madhya Pradesh became India's 58th Tiger Reserve.

nf1b912a891e.s: Impatiens karuppusamyi, in the news, is a new species of:
nf1b912a891e.x: Impatiens karuppusamyi is a new plant species described by the Botanical Survey of India.

n89ab2540d2d.s: Which of the following pairs (index/report – released by) is correctly matched?
o: Global Talent Competitiveness Index – World Justice Project
World Inequality Report 2026 – World Inequality Lab
Rule of Law Index – UN DESA
World Economic Situation and Prospects 2026 – INSEAD
n89ab2540d2d.x: The World Inequality Report 2026 is by the World Inequality Lab. GTCI is by INSEAD, the Rule of Law Index by the World Justice Project and WESP 2026 by UN DESA.

n65a494671c3.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
n65a494671c3.x: The Global Wage Report is released by the ILO, not UNCTAD.

n738e8d5099f.s: India's rank in the Global Innovation Index 2025 (out of 139 economies) was:
n738e8d5099f.x: India ranked 38th of 139 in GII 2025, up from 81st in 2015 and 48th in 2020.

ncc039201fde.s: In V-Dem 2026, India was classified as:
ncc039201fde.x: V-Dem 2026 ranked India 106th of 179 in the Electoral Democracy Index and classified it as an electoral autocracy.

n8b4715f1286.s:
Consider the following statements about India's positions in 2026:
1. The Global Gender Gap 2026 placed India 131st.
2. V-Dem 2026 placed India 176th.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n8b4715f1286.x: The Global Gender Gap 2026 (17 September 2026) placed India 131st; V-Dem 2026 placed India 106th, not 176th.

ne54e591fd4e.s:
Consider the following statements about the weights in the Global Hunger Index:
1. Undernourishment and under-five mortality get one-third weight each.
2. Child stunting and child wasting get one-sixth weight each.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ne54e591fd4e.x: The GHI gives one-third each to undernourishment and under-five mortality, and one-sixth each to child stunting and child wasting.

n48e66603308.s:
Consider the following statements about PGI 2.0 2025–26:
1. No state reached the top Utkarsh grade.
2. Chandigarh became the first to reach Uttam-3.
3. Meghalaya was the highest performer.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n48e66603308.x: No state reached Utkarsh and Chandigarh first reached Uttam-3; Meghalaya was the lowest, not the highest, performer.

naa321a832fd.s:
Consider the following statements about the Ramon Magsaysay Award:
1. Educate Girls became the first Indian organisation to win it, in 2025.
2. 2026 awardee Tommy Koh is from Singapore.
3. 2026 awardees Runa Khan and Bo Kyi are from Bangladesh and Myanmar respectively.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
naa321a832fd.x: All three are correct: Educate Girls was the first Indian organisation to win (2025), and the 2026 awardees included Tommy Koh (Singapore), Runa Khan (Bangladesh) and Bo Kyi (Myanmar).

nf11cbaea2a7.s:
Consider the following statements about the Dronacharya Award:
1. It is given to coaches.
2. It was instituted in 1985.
3. It is a lifetime award for sportspersons.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nf11cbaea2a7.x: The Dronacharya Award, instituted in 1985, is for coaches, not a lifetime award for sportspersons.

ncb1e3936da1.s: In 2024, the Bharat Ratna was conferred on how many awardees, including P.V. Narasimha Rao?
ncb1e3936da1.x: The Bharat Ratna was last given in 2024 to five awardees, including former Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao.

nfa4a2bdd246.s: The second investiture of the 2026 Padma awards was held at:
nfa4a2bdd246.x: The 2026 Padma awards were presented in two investitures, the second at Ganatantra Mandap, Rashtrapati Bhavan.

n6e0e848fa5e.s: Taiwan Travelogue, the International Booker Prize 2026 winner, was the first winner written in:
n6e0e848fa5e.x: Taiwan Travelogue was the first Mandarin Chinese winner of the International Booker; its £50,000 prize was split between author and translator.

n8286184e1c3.s:
Consider the following pairs:
1. Pasumarthi Rattaiah Sarma – Kuchipudi
2. Sudharani Raghupathy – Akademi Ratna 2024-25
3. Rita Ganguly – Akademi Ratna 2024-25
Which of the above pairs is/are correctly matched?
n8286184e1c3.x: All are correct: Rattaiah Sarma is a Kuchipudi exponent, and Sudharani Raghupathy and Rita Ganguly are among the seven Akademi Ratna recipients for 2024-25.

n0c48a1fcdb7.s: Which of the following country – honour pairs is correctly matched?
o: Slovakia – Order of the White Double Cross, First Class
Indonesia – Grand Cross of the Royal Norwegian Order of Merit
n0c48a1fcdb7.x: Slovakia's honour is the Order of the White Double Cross, First Class. Ethiopia's is the Great Honour Nishan, Norway's the Royal Norwegian Order of Merit and Indonesia's the Bintang Adipurna.

n876b4bd18aa.s: Which of the following country – honour pairs (2026) is correctly matched?
o: Indonesia – Royal Order of the Polar Star
Seychelles – Guardian of the Blue Horizon
n876b4bd18aa.x: Seychelles' honour is the Guardian of the Blue Horizon. Sweden's is the Royal Order of the Polar Star, Indonesia's the Bintang Adipurna and Uzbekistan's the Oliy Darajali Do'stlik Order.

nb25a6360176.s: Which of the following post – holder pairs is correctly matched?
o: Chief Justice of India – C.P. Radhakrishnan
Governor of the RBI – Surya Kant
nb25a6360176.x: Gyanesh Kumar is the CEC. Surya Kant is the CJI, C.P. Radhakrishnan the Vice-President and Sanjay Malhotra the RBI Governor.

n1f4fc7acaea.s:
Consider the following statements about the Sahitya Akademi:
1. It was founded in 1952.
2. It was inaugurated on 12 March 1954.
3. It was registered as a society in 1961.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n1f4fc7acaea.x: The Sahitya Akademi was founded in 1952, inaugurated on 12 March 1954 and registered as a society in 1956, not 1961.

nce05c1490bd.s:
Regarding India at the FIDE World Rapid 2025 in Doha, consider the following:
1. Koneru Humpy and Arjun Erigaisi won bronze medals.
2. Arjun Erigaisi became the first Indian man on the podium.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nce05c1490bd.x: Humpy and Arjun won bronze at Doha 2025; Arjun was the second Indian man on the podium, after Viswanathan Anand.

n36a27643986.s:
Consider the following statements about the 5th Khelo India University Games:
1. It was held in Rajasthan.
2. Beach volleyball was added for the first time.
3. Canoeing-kayaking and cycling were added for the first time.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n36a27643986.x: Rajasthan hosted the 5th KIUG, which introduced beach volleyball, canoeing-kayaking and cycling.

n1a95d883a75.s: At the Khelo India Winter Games 2026, ice and snow events were held, respectively, at:
n1a95d883a75.x: The 6th Khelo India Winter Games used Leh for ice events and Gulmarg for snow events; figure skating was added for the first time.

n61554f6d5d1.s: Which of the following place – sports development pairs in Andhra Pradesh is correctly matched?
o: Kakinada, Kadapa and Pulivendula – 27-acre Komadi integrated complex
n61554f6d5d1.x: Vijayawada's IGMC Stadium is under phased renovation. Rajamahendravaram hosted the Dragon Boat League, Visakhapatnam has the Komadi complex, and Kakinada, Kadapa and Pulivendula have AP's only hockey turfs.
